pronunciation: yoo · til · ih · TAIR · ee · un
definition: Designed to be useful rather than attractive or enjoyable.
author: Oscar Wilde
quote: Surely such a utilitarian occupation as the watering of flowers is rather Moulton’s duty than yours?
example_sentence: The office furniture was strictly utilitarian.
